title: Item Assets Definition Extension
description: STAC Item Assets Definition Extension for STAC Collections.

href.title: Disallow href
href.description: Item Asset Definitions must not have an `href`: they do not point to any data by themselves.

title.title: Asset title
title.description: The displayed title for clients and users.

description.title: Asset description
description.description: A description of the Asset providing additional details, such as how it was processed or created. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

roles.title: Asset roles
roles.description: The semantic roles of the asset, similar to the use of `rel` in links.
